sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is semantically sufficient: the supplied terms cover operands and a boolean evidence flag, but none defines the required patch-to-case/location correspondence or the minimisation comparison relationship.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the shape does not faithfully encode the requirement. It targets every generic structuralMember rather than restricting applicability to webFrame or loadCarryingStringer, omits the required ship-to-iceLoadPatch relationship for the patch defined in I2.3, and reduces the minimisation comparison to an unconditional memberCapacityMinimizationConfirmed=true assertion. Constrain the member alternatives using the supplied canonical classes, include hasIceLoadPatch on the ship and its required linkage to the design case/load case, and represent or directly validate that the load patch location corresponds to the minimum member capacity under the combined bending-and-shear effect rather than accepting a presence-only boolean.

Reject. Preserve the prior repairs: constrain checks to applicable webFrame or loadCarryingStringer members, encode the required linkage between the ship's ice-load patch and the applicable structural-member load cases, and do not use memberCapacityMinimizationConfirmed=true as a presence-only substitute for the minimisation comparison. The COMPLETE DIRECT_STATIC contract requires the declared operands combinedShearBendingEffect, memberCapacity, and loadPatchApplicationLocation, the declared owner/path relationships, and a faithful check that the selected load-patch location is where each applicable member's capacity under combined bending and shear is minimised. The current graph merely requires string-valued operands and an unconditional boolean, with no comparison or location-to-case/patch correspondence. Also avoid imposing sh:minCount 1 on the ship's structural-member collection unless existence is independently required; a universal rule over applicable members does not establish existence. Activate the matcher because the scoped vocabulary supplies no canonical term/path sufficient to express the missing patch-to-case/location correspondence or comparison relationship.
